title: Compose the authoritative Plant card in the PWA

gates.name: plant_history_card_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/plant-history-card.spec.ts

verify: Independent browser/API verification covers only the active and retained-authorized Plant card, safe fields/errors, and absence of direct Timeline/path access.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-021 RED: no PWA Plant-card consumer exists; GREEN: active and archived-authorized card responses render exact refs, freshness, counts, permissions, and retained-history mode while denied/inconsistent cases fail safely; decisive comparison: protected response versus DOM plus direct-Timeline/path/auth absence; artifact: card evidence under .tasks/TASK-085-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose the safe authoritative Plant card through its owning projection instead of giving the PWA Timeline or storage access.
success_outcome: Authorized users can view the active or retained-authorized Plant card with exact safe refs, freshness, counts, permissions, and mode while the PWA performs no history or Timeline mutation.
anti_goals: Do not implement paginated history, read or replay timeline.jsonl, query PostgreSQL directly, expose local paths, or build an export package.
Do not make archived retained-history access operational or materialize new work.

forbidden_scope: timeline replay or direct file access
stop_conditions: Required history data is absent from Plant History HTTP and would require a direct Timeline/data bypass.
Archived presentation would create or advance operational state.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Plant History is the sole presentation provider for card/history/timeline refs.
Use backend-selected active versus retained-history authority and canonical cursor behavior.
invariants: Timeline remains append-only audit/export and never becomes PWA runtime authority.
Archived history is retained presentation only and creates no new rows or operational transition.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-021: exact active/retained-authorized Plant card and safe denial with no direct Timeline/path surface.
T3 harm proof uses isolated history state and confirms denied/malformed/archived reads leave no mutation residue.
